basics.name: Ian Leonard
basics.label: Manufacturing Operations Leader & AI Systems Builder
basics.summary: Manufacturing operations leader and designer-turned-builder based in San Diego. I run production operations day to day and design and ship the AI systems, agents, and internal tools that make a business run. Designer by training, operator by trade.

projects.name: The Content Operative
projects.description: AI content agent: ramble in (typed, dictated, or phone voice memo), on-brand draft out. Learns a voice fingerprint, runs voice and compliance checks on every draft, and drafts straight into a newsletter platform — never auto-publishing.
highlights: Atomizes raw input into idea cards
Drafts in a learned voice fingerprint
Drafts-only, human approval to publish

projects.name: Vault Agent Fleet
projects.description: A fleet of specialized AI agents that reads any file dropped into one inbox — notes, PDFs, images, audio, video — classifies, tags, links, extracts action items, and files it into a single searchable knowledge base. Runs in the cloud on a schedule.
highlights: Sorter routes files to 8 specialized workers
Multimodal: audio, video, image to text
Surfaces cross-project opportunities

projects.name: The Harvester
projects.description: Paste a YouTube URL, pick a lens; an AI pipeline watches the video, synthesizes it through that point of view, writes a structured briefing into a knowledge base, and routes action items to the right project.

projects.name: The Forge
projects.description: A visual workflow builder paired with a generic execution engine — draw an automation as a graph of nodes; one interpreter runs any graph. Built to be self-hostable.

projects.name: Retail Investor Platform
projects.description: A live web application for income-focused investors: screening tools, return simulator, fund-flow intelligence, AI research dossier, brokerage sync, and a member area on a real database. Designed, built, and deployed end to end.

projects.name: Yield Observatory
projects.description: A fast static dashboard tracking stablecoin and real-world-asset yields with reliability scoring, AI-authored per-venue risk dossiers, and an issuer directory, built entirely on public data.

projects.name: Podcast Studio
projects.description: A browser-based recording studio: capture audio or video, edit by tapping words in the transcript, auto-generate cover art, and publish to a clean episode page. Editing runs on-device.

projects.name: Field Ops Console
projects.description: An operations console that syncs live jobs, sites, and field devices into one application with project and device detail pages — a real production tool running day-to-day field work.

projects.name: Income Data API
projects.description: A paid API exposing the income-ETF dataset for programmatic and agent access — tiered keys, a free tier, and a metered wall for automated consumers.

projects.name: The Vault System
projects.description: A structured markdown knowledge base backed by a database with semantic search, plus a server that lets any AI assistant read and write it directly — one source of truth shared across every agent.

work.name: Utility Systems Science + Software
work.summary: Four years running production operations day to day for a live manufacturing business: leading the production team, owning throughput, cost and quality, running purchasing and ordering, and shipping product to customers nationwide. Designer by training, operator by trade — and I built and deployed the operating system the floor now runs on while doing the job.
highlights: Run the production floor day to day — scheduling, throughput, quality and output
Hire and train the technician team
Own purchasing and ordering end to end
Own shipping and receiving; ship product to customers across the country
Lead hardware solutions design
Designed and deployed the company operating system the floor runs on
Translated operator pain into software that ships, then ran it in production

work.name: Independent maker / builder
work.summary: Cargo-trailer tiny home (lived in 6 months, NYC → San Diego), commissioned architectural lighting for NYC bars and restaurants, custom furniture and built-ins, and production AI agents and apps. Same craftsman’s standard across maple, black pipe, and multi-agent pipelines.
highlights: Off-grid cargo-trailer home conversion
Architectural lighting installations for NYC bars and restaurants
Custom furniture, built-ins and outdoor builds
Production AI systems and open-source builder tools

work.name: NOTB Construction · Poliform Italian Designs · Temili Design Corp.
work.summary: Hands-on trade work across three New York shops and sites: custom indoor and outdoor builds, precision installation of Italian prefab kitchens and closets, and custom furniture fabrication.
highlights: Trained install specialist for Poliform Italy kitchens and closets — site survey and dimensional verification before every install
Floor-to-ceiling installations for clients across New York City
Cabinet construction, veneering and custom furnishings
Daily quality assurance for the lead project manager on custom builds
